text:
Dov Benyaacov-Kurtzman
"A genuine tourist" 😂
So a tourist for you could only be a person who is coming to sunbathe at the dead sea and stay in an hotel?

I can't say I'm surprised that someone who worked for the border administration is saying this. This is fucked up on so many different levels.

Family members can be tourists. Spouses and partners of Israelis can be tourists. 
PIBA's prejudice of relatives is ridiculous and unlawful, and harms the rights of Israeli *citizens*, not only foreigners. A serious shake up of border policies is required.
And actually the best proof of what I say is you here, a former border officer, hinting people they should conceal their identities and true purpose of visit.
